title: Sustainability of Tray and Crockery Return Movements at Hawker Centres, Coffee Shops and Food Courts
what_it_is: Sustainability of Tray and Crockery Return Movements at Hawker Centres, Coffee Shops and Food Courts

sections.label: Tray return rate checks
sections.summary: The average Tray and Crockery Return Rate at hawker centres, coffeeshops and food courts is around 90%, and NEA and SFA conduct checks focusing on premises with a lower rate.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: To date, the average Tray and Crockery Return Rate, or TCRR, at hawker centres, coffeeshops and food courts is around 90%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: To ensure the cleanliness of our public dining spaces, the National Environment Agency (NEA) and the Singapore Food Agency (SFA) have been conducting checks, with focus on premises with a lower TCRR.

sections.label: Enforcement for non-returned trays
sections.summary: A minority still do not return used crockery and trays; NEA and SFA conduct checks and enforcement, with written warnings and composition fines for repeat offenders.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But, nonetheless, this also means that there is a minority, a small proportion who still do not return their used crockery and tray after their meals.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And some might not do it unless the enforcement officer advises them to do so, because if they heed the advice of the enforcement officers, no action will be taken.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: A written warning will only be issued if they do not heed the advice and, subsequently, if they offend again, it will be a composition fine.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: What we have done is, NEA and SFA have continued to conduct checks and enforcements, particularly in premises with a lower TCRR.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We do that and work closely with the Town Councils, as well as with the hawker associations and stallholders to get them, for instance, to remind these diners to return their used crockery and tray, as well as to ensure that there is sufficient tray return infrastructure and signages to remind and raise awareness about the requirement.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In addition to that, we will continue to monitor the situation and we will, as the Member has pointed out, look at a review of the deployment of our enforcement officers if need be, as well as consider the option of firmer actions should the situation warrant it.
